correctness.rationale: For n≥4 the triangular graph T_n=L(K_n) has diameter two. Every inclusion-maximal geodesic has three line-graph vertices corresponding to the three edges of an ordinary P4 subgraph of K_n, and conversely; every adjacent pair extends. Thus the omitted-edge root graph of a geodesic transversal is ordinary P4-free, whose connected components are isolated vertices, stars or triangles. The exponential formula over labeled root components yields the submitted A_n(t). Inclusion-minimal transversals correspond to edge-maximal ordinary P4-free graphs, exactly edge/triangle/star≥3-leaf components covering all root labels or one isolated vertex plus all triangles. This gives B_n(t), the extremal formulas, and counts. Independent exhaustive n=4,5,6 enumeration and component-EGF comparison give (30,131,712) all transversals and (11,15,91) minimal. The unrestricted classification, not these finite checks, proves the result.
